Limit[n=10]
  Sort[keys=revenue DESC, item_count DESC]
    Project[c.mktsegment AS mktsegment, c.nation AS nation, item_count, revenue]
      Filter[sum(l.extended_price) > 5000.0]
        Aggregate[group=c.mktsegment, c.nation, aggs=count(*) AS item_count, sum(l.extended_price) AS revenue]
          Filter[l.ship_date >= '1995-01-01' AND o.order_priority = '1-URGENT']
            Join[kind=inner, cond=o.id = l.order_id]
              Join[kind=inner, cond=c.id = o.cust_id]
                Scan[customer]
                Scan[orders]
              Scan[lineitem]
